findings.fix: Qualify the claim and update the hypothesis-layout overview to mention the field-only Cartan–Dieudonné dichotomy.

findings.evidence: Lines 51–53 quantify `r : QuadraticMap.orthogonalGroup Q` and assert only `r ∈ (pinToOrthogonal Q).range`.
findings.fix: Say that `r` is the image under `pinToOrthogonal` of a lift of one reflection or two reflections.
